answer.summary: The Spring Boot 4 bump in pom.xml (Renovate PR) leaves a Micrometer classpath mismatch. The app context fails to start with NoSuchMethodError on DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder, so Tomcat never comes up and the cascade fails 254 of 634 API tests. This is deterministic and tied to the change, so a retry will fail again. Align the Micrometer versions with the Boot 4 BOM in pom.xml.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
